claim.quote: We report a precise measurement of the parity-violating asymmetry $A_{\rm PV}$ in the elastic scattering of longitudinally polarized electrons from $^{48}{\rm Ca}$.

key_value_text.quote: The resulting neutron skin thickness $R_n-R_p=0.121 \pm 0.026\ {\rm (exp)} \pm 0.024\ {\rm (model)}$~fm is relatively thin yet consistent with many model calculations.

name: CREX: precision determination of the neutral weak form factor of 48Ca

summary.plain: CREX measured the neutral weak form factor of calcium-48 with spin-flipped electrons. The resulting neutron skin, 0.121 ± 0.026 (experiment) ± 0.024 (model) femtometres, is relatively thin and in tension with the thick skin found for lead.
summary.technical: A_PV = 2668 ± 106 (stat) ± 40 (syst) ppb in elastic scattering from 48Ca, giving F_W(q = 0.8733 fm^-1) = 0.1304 ± 0.0052 (stat) ± 0.0020 (syst), F_ch - F_W = 0.0277 ± 0.0055 and R_n - R_p = 0.121 ± 0.026 (exp) ± 0.024 (model) fm.

title: Precision Determination of the Neutral Weak Form Factor of $^{48}$Ca
why_it_matters: Together with PREX the result challenges energy-density-functional calculations and constrains the density dependence of the symmetry energy of nuclear matter.
